option.name: originalContent
option.value:
services: postgres: image: postgres:16-alpine container_name: disaster-aid-postgres restart: unless-stopped environment: POSTGRES_USER: postgres POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres POSTGRES_DB: disaster_aid ports: - "5432:5432" volumes: - disaster-aid-pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data - ./docker/postgres-init:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d:ro healthcheck: test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U postgres -d disaster_aid"] interval: 5s timeout: 5s retries: 10
pgadmin: image: dpage/pgadmin4:latest container_name: disaster-aid-pgadmin restart: unless-stopped environment: PGADMIN_DEFAULT_EMAIL: admin@example.com PGADMIN_DEFAULT_PASSWORD: admin PGADMIN_CONFIG_SERVER_MODE: "False" PGADMIN_CONFIG_MASTER_PASSWORD_REQUIRED: "False" ports: - "5050:80" volumes: - disaster-aid-pgadmin:/var/lib/pgadmin - ./docker/pgadmin/servers.json:/pgadmin4/servers.json:ro depends_on: postgres: condition: service_healthy
volumes: disaster-aid-pgdata: disaster-aid-pgadmin:
